iconicAnchor.label: The Serai Wing's context-sensitive boutique hotel interiors
iconicAnchor.creatorOrTradition: ANARCHITECT and contemporary boutique hospitality design
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: RIBA documents a small hospitality project where differentiated rooms, tranquil courtyards, refined local materials, heritage layers, and contemporary service needs form one guest experience.

sources.title: The Serai Wing, Bait Khalid Bin Ibrahim
supports: Boutique hospitality can derive room character from context, existing architecture, local material, and a coherent guest program.
Tranquil courtyards, refined material layers, and identifiable new interventions support warm but specific spatial luxury.

sources.title: The Porter House Hotel
supports: Craftsmanship, site history, material application, commissioned art, and privacy can align across a hospitality interior.
Clear circulation and accessible guest rooms establish that atmosphere must remain tied to service and use.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set.
